body:
## Confirmed reproduction on 458f8eaad142de927f889f78d5adc8ac85eb73d3

Start a room-plan placement while its worker preflight reply is in flight. Load a genuine encoded V8 save or start a new prison. The existing main onWorkerAvailability callback stands down the shared tool, and SimulationWorkerChannel correctly suppresses the outgoing worker reply. Rearm and inspect an available origin in the replacement session: its current worker says clear. Placement still returns `{ok:false,reason:"busy"}` and sends zero command messages to the replacement worker.

The old requester's normal 15,000ms timeout eventually releases RoomTemplateTool.busy. The same new-session placement then works. This is a responsiveness defect, not an observed stale-owner purchase or hidden debit.

## Evidence

Offline source test runs actual SimulationWorkerStateMachine, SimulationWorkerChannel, WorkerPerSessionHost, SimulationCommandSender, createSimulationRoomTemplatePreflight and the exact current main availability callback. Only transport delivery of a real preflight reply is held. No verdict, world/entity data, runtime or ownership is injected. The Load path captures a genuine pending Cell, creates/encodes/decodes V8, then starts a fresh worker with that decoded bundle.

Baseline: **2 RED / 1 same-session delayed legal GREEN**, 2.61s. Both replacement workers are paused. Before/after the suppressed attempt, the entire authoritative snapshot is identical, treasury is 25,000, and command count is zero. New: 0 orders remain0. Load: 18 orders remain18. After advancing the unchanged 15s requester timer in the offline clock, actual recovery adds18 shell orders / one pending plan. No native/browser claim.

## Cause and proposed narrow scope

RoomTemplateTool has one boolean busy spanning session generations. standDown increments selection revision only if armed and never clears that busy owner. Clear the abandoned operation at the existing standDown boundary, and identify the in-flight placement with an ephemeral ownership token. A stale finally must never clear the token of a replacement operation. No main/worker-host/bridge change should be needed; no persistence/protocol/copy/tariff change.

## Duplicate check

Fresh repository searches: `preflight session`, `room template busy`, `room plan timeout`, `projection disposed`. Read complete #1947 (armed ghost across session), #1934 (late numeric status against a new card), #1907/#1908 (interrupted pointer/old accepted ghost). None covers the busy owner surviving the fresh session. Correct channel old-reply suppression must remain intact.
title: Pending room-plan preflight keeps the tool busy after Load or New prison
